values.note: $20 a night, with the fee and registration procedure posted at the campground kiosk. A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry to every state forest campground.

fees.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/houselake ('Overnight fees ($20 for most sites) and registration procedures are posted at the information kiosk at each campground'; 'A Recreation Passport (park pass) is required for vehicle entry into all state park and forest campgrounds') + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/state-forest-campgrounds/amenity-table (House Lake State Forest Campground, Gladwin: 41 sites, $20), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Drinking water from a hand-pump well. Gravel boat launch on Hoister Lake.

facilities.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/houselake ('There are vault toilets.' 'Potable (drinking) water is available from a hand-pump well.' 'A gravel boat launch is located on Hoister Lake, near House Lake.'), read 2026-10-25

booking.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/houselake ('No reservations. Sites available on a first-come, first-served basis.' 'Camping is limited to a 15-day maximum stay.') + amenity table (House Lake: 'Reservable at MiDNRReservations.com' no), read 2026-10-25

values.note: 41 sites in two loops, 35 of which take a 40-ft vehicle/trailer. One camping unit and six people per site.

sites.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/houselake ('There are 41 campsites available, 35 of which will accommodate a 40-foot vehicle/trailer.'; 'The campground is split into two loops.'; 'One camping unit and six people are allowed per site') + amenity table (41 campsites), read 2026-10-25

note: Secluded rustic state forest campground beside the Gladwin Field Trial Area, 17 mi N of Gladwin via M-18 and Adams Road; two loops, both with water access to House and Hoister lakes. Gravel boat launch on Hoister Lake (electric motors, kayaks and canoes); trail access to the 2.8-mile Trout Lake Pathway; Trout Lake State Forest Campground is next door to the north. Managed by Wilson State Park. --Claude
summary: DNR page + SF amenity table: 41 sites, 35 to 40 ft (confirmed), $20 at the kiosk + Recreation Passport, no electric, vault toilets, hand-pump water, gravel launch, first-come only, 15-day maximum (all confirmed). Season (open all year) already manual and matches. Phone 989-539-3021 matches the campground page (the amenity table gives the managing Wilson SP, 989-386-4067). Note trimmed of field restatements.
